slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about the definition of overtime relative to 110 hours, but never asked whether fully utilizing 110 hours is a hard constraint or a soft goal, nor about its priority relative to other objectives.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether there is an upper limit and learned of the 10-hour overtime cap, but never asked whether this cap is a strict constraint or a soft prioritized goal, nor about its priority relative to minimizing overtime.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 110 regular hours are treated as a fixed capacity, and the agent did not confirm whether full utilization of 110 hours is a hard constraint or a soft goal with priority.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent's questions framed 110 hours as regular capacity and 120 total hours as available time, but never explicitly confirmed the goal/constraint nature or priority of the 110-hour utilization requirement.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 10-hour overtime cap is treated as a hard upper limit rather than a prioritized soft goal.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent asked about an upper limit and accepted the 10-hour cap, but never asked whether it is a strict constraint or a soft target with priority relative to minimizing overtime.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation ended without a READY_TO_MODEL or equivalent final modeling state, and both P0 hidden slots remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified several data and background points but failed to probe the two P0 goal-structure slots about whether the 110-hour utilization and 10-hour overtime cap are hard constraints or prioritized soft goals; it also repeated the same inventory question many times without reaching a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
